title: Theory that nuclear fuels were used to alter gravity and time on nuclear bases

tellings.quote: nuclear fuels were used mid-century to alter gravity we know that gravity and time are linked in general relativity

plain: Michels floats the idea that nuclear fuels were used in the mid-twentieth century to alter gravity on nuclear bases, and since gravity and time are linked in Einstein's general relativity, perhaps to alter time as well. He offers it as his own speculation, comparing it to the plot of the Netflix series Dark, as one way to explain why UFOs seem drawn to nuclear sites.
